review.notes: Four distinct crowns at 115 studs: red needle-spire cluster, blue pyramid roofs with dormers, green half-timber manor with hipped roof (reads more manor/town hall than keep), yellow onion domes on chunky open drums. Grayscale: all four separable; red vs blue is the closest pair (cones vs pyramids). Door banners carry crown/star/oak/sun. Yellow sun = cream roundel with gold sunburst: not a C, not gold-on-gold, but at 115 studs the rays merge into a ringed dot/rosette. Yellow keep reads as a fantasy kremlin, not a mosque (no slender minarets), though the 1 big + 4 small dome pattern is church-like; consider squatter corner domes. The disc finial under the central-dome flag should get the same fix as tower/gatehouse (disc reads as a crescent in grayscale). Flags are colour-only stripes (identical in grayscale). 13.3-14.1k of 16k (83-88%), little headroom. Sheet: gameplay strip keeps overlap each other.
